limits: This is static source/hash review, not execution, live remote release evidence, or publication success.
No target code or fixtures were run by the reviewer; no OAuth, credential body, SSH, Docker or API was accessed.
Archive all-blob/diffID validation remains the original verifier record bound by unchanged archive digest; this failure reader does not rerun the OCI verifier.
Local record persistence assumes writable local storage; any missing/error terminal or incomplete stream remains pending and cannot authorize replay or merge.
The current PR239 CI gate is independent and remains held pending its own evidence.
readOnlyScope: Only fixed c3e directory, private original records, approved archive current size/hash, original PID/start-ticks state, temporary-auth path and IPv4/IPv6 port7897 release are observed.
The fixed success-only observe function is not called. Only its fixed private-read/hash/PID/route helpers are imported.
Failed original terminal must remain unknown-stopped with 1 export, 0 push, approved original request/source/destination/grant/operations hashes and one of two bounded pre-credential stop errors.
The three original source-before/export-once/source-after CLIs require zero exit, recorded reaped and original-PID absence; their bounded streams must match recorded byte hashes.
Original raw index/platform/config/layer descriptors and diffIDs are bound; original archive is current-size/hash checked without exposing config or Env.
Eighteen fixed later-operation records, temporary-auth dir/config and port7897 must be absent.
No Docker/provider/credential API, write or retry is added remotely. SSH uses no agent, no inherited forwarding, no shared master/control socket and in-memory pinned source only.
Both success and pending readback reports preserve publicationSucceeded=false and mergeAllowed=false.

resolvedMustFixes.issue: Failure-reader bytes were not hard-pinned locally; SSH timeout/start failure skipped terminal and observed-stream persistence.
resolvedMustFixes.resolution: Failure reader, shared reader, local stop helper/common/scope are now exact-SHA pinned. A single original SSH Popen records PID, collects bounded streams with a 180-second observation bound, invokes the already-reviewed stop_owned in finally and writes observed streams plus terminal with error/reaped/stopErrors/streamsMayBeIncomplete before reporting pending.
